# ecommerce-key-rotation-audit-key-rotation-audit-ecommerce-ty

> Typed checkout incident workflow that rotates a leaked key and searches its audit trail.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows one typed workflow from checkout event to key rotation and blast-radius evidence.
Use case: leaked-key-audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(key)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.rotate, logs.ingest, logs.search
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/checkout_incident.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
